scope: Local implementation and production validation; not deployed.
behavior: Language changes retain the page, query, and fragment.
Homepage category filters, search, wheel controls, presets, results, guides, and metadata use the selected language.
CSV controls, invoice previews and PDF labels, net-worth history, and built-in toolkit examples are localized.
User-entered text, stored data, algorithm IDs, numeric inputs, and select option values are preserved.
Wheel edits and homepage filters wait for hydration.
Translated content is stored in the repository; no translation service runs in the website.

translationReview.method: Google machine-assisted drafts for missing public page copy; direct revisions for wheel terminology, names, key controls, and selected Filipino titles. Existing translations retained.
translationReview.checks: Complete message coverage, placeholders, numeric and formula notation, preserved proper names, valid preset lengths, identical numerical calculations, and visual Arabic/Hindi mobile review.
translationReview.limit: No comprehensive independent native-speaker review. Automated coverage checks do not establish linguistic accuracy.

productionCrawl.scope: All sitemap URLs; initial server HTML; unique internal path targets. No external links, fragment targets, JavaScript rendering, search-engine indexing status, or field performance measured.

indexing: Existing deployment-controlled indexing remains unchanged. The local SEO audit used a build with NEXT_PUBLIC_INDEXABLE=true and the canonical Host header.
